alerts.text: 7 world markets made big moves over the past week: US 10-year bond yield +0.29 pts, Nikkei 225 +6.5%, Euro in rupees −2.0%, Ethereum −13.8%, DAX +3.6%, Gold −4.6%, Bitcoin −9.9%.

Foreign investors raised their stake in 11 of 16 stocks: +0.20 pp, worth about ₹641 Cr at today's prices. The group trails the NIFTY 500 by 0.8% over three months, so the buying has not shown up in the price yet. Domestic institutions added too.
